verdict.rationale: Orb documents a dedicated Stripe Billing migration path with event backfill and parallel-running to validate before cutover, supporting a 'customers don't notice' migration for at least one competing platform (docs-13,14,35,36). However, there is no evidence of spreadsheet-based import tooling or of PCI-compliant card/payment-method data transfer, which is a core part of this story. Missing for 10: spreadsheet import workflow, explicit PCI-compliant card data migration/tokenization handling, and migration guides for platforms beyond Stripe.
